rule: Join to crypto 1h panel on symbol and timestamp.
For timestamp t as hour bucket start, all aggTrades features are available only after t + 1h.
Primary experiments should use at least next-bar execution after feature availability; same-hour close execution is forbidden.
Experiment code must read enhanced_v1 gold parquet, not raw zip.
fast version is fallback only; enhanced_v1 is the main microstructure feature source after acceptance.
Current accepted dataset is core3 BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT for 2024-01 through 2026-04; do not treat it as core12.
